title: What's New : AL-Go for GitHub on Quality and Testability (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction and Page Scripting Tests Overview
Page Scripting Test Support and BC Replay Module
Page Scripting Test Demo and Configuration

features.name: Page Scripting Tests in AL-Go Workflow
features.description: Support for running page scripting tests in AL-Go for GitHub workflow using the BC replay npm module released in Business Central 2024 Wave 2.
caveats: Requires BC replay npm module from 2024 Wave 2
Page scripting recording must be generated in Business Central first

features.name: Page Scripting Test Result Visualizer
features.description: Visual display of page scripting test results in AL-Go showing pass/fail status with downloadable artifacts including video recordings of test failures.
caveats: Requires extended logs to view video of test execution

features.name: Deploy Test Apps to Sandbox
features.description: Feature to deploy test apps alongside production apps to sandbox environments during deployment process in AL-Go settings.
caveats: Test apps with external dependencies may be auto-excluded

features.name: Exclude Apps by ID During Deployment
features.description: Ability to exclude specific apps by their ID during deployment to environments using the exclude app IDs array setting in AL-Go configuration.
caveats: Must specify app IDs as array in configuration
Test apps with missing dependencies are automatically excluded

features.name: Automatic Test App Dependency Resolution
features.description: AL-Go automatically detects and excludes test apps that depend on libraries not available in AppSource gallery during deployment.
caveats: Applies to both standard and custom deployment scripts

features.name: Page Scripting Test Settings Configuration
features.description: Configuration options in project settings to point to page scripting recording folders with support for multiple folders and pattern matching.
caveats: Requires recordings to be generated externally in Business Central

features.name: Custom Deployment Script Test App Support
features.description: Test apps are passed to custom deployment scripts when include test apps setting is enabled, allowing script authors to handle dependency installation.
caveats: Requires custom script implementation to handle test apps
Script author responsible for dependency management
